newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cuts internal coffee prices by 8.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cuts internal coffee prices by 8.38 pct.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation cut domestic coffee prices by 8.38 percent to 333,250 pesos per 125-kg load Monday, a spokesman said.
The price cut, down from 363,750 pesos per 125-kg load, was based on an average selling price of $1.98 per pound on the New York Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange.
The new price is the second cut since December 5 when the internal coffee price was set at 221,500 pesos.
The price has been raised six times since then under the terms of a new sliding scale system introduced by the federation to calculate payments to growers.

The price is normally set every seven days and is based onn the average international trading price of Colombian coffee. The new figure was not announced last Friday due to the Good Friday bank holiday.
